feed.title: NPR Topics: Home Page Top Stories
feed.subtitle: Top stories in the U.S. and world news, politics, health, science, business, music, arts and culture. Nonprofit journalism with a mission. This is NPR.

entry.title: This summer was hot. August shattered global heat records
entry.summary: Scientists say that August was the hottest month ever recorded globally. In the U.S., summer temperatures also shattered heat records.

entry.title: Lawsuit challenges intimidation of DHS observers across the country
entry.summary: The sweeping lawsuit brought by Common Cause argues federal agencies are illegally surveilling and intimidating people who try to peacefully observe federal immigration enforcement activity.

entry.title: A fossil feather from the age of dinosaurs may explain why only some birds survived
entry.summary: An extremely well preserved fossil feather could reveal why some birds survived the dinosaur-killing asteroid, and others did not.

entry.title: How the WNBA became a political prop in the culture wars
entry.summary: Sports journalist Sabreena Merchant says culture war issues related to race and trans athletes threaten to overshadow exceptional play on the WNBA court.

entry.title: Barbara Keating died in the 9/11 attack. She's finally being laid to rest
entry.summary: Barbara Keating died aboard one of the planes that hijackers slammed into the World Trade Center. Her remains were finally identified last year, and her family is gathering for a long-delayed funeral.

entry.title: Elon Musk threatens to sue over Gibney documentary's "space lasers" claim
entry.summary: The tech billionaire's attorney has put documentarian Alex Gibney and his production company on legal notice, claiming the Oscar-winning director defamed Musk in his nearly four-hour documentary.

entry.title: 'I've never seen anything like this' -- A U.S. doctor treats Ebola's youngest victims
entry.summary: Dr. Rupa Narra is a U.S. pediatrician who arrived in the Democratic Republic of Congo to help care for stricken children. Nothing could have prepared her for what she'd face.

entry.title: What to watch this fall: Here are 16 TV shows we're looking forward to
entry.summary: An East of Eden adaptation, a reboot of A Different World, Matthew McConaughey and Woody Harrelson playing (possible) brothers ... Here's a sneak peek at what NPR critics will be watching in the next few months.

entry.title: One year after Charlie Kirk's death, Turning Point USA faces an uncertain future
entry.summary: The death of Charlie Kirk was seen as a rallying call for young conservatives. But as his supporters reflect on the past year, some paint a more complicated picture of the organization he left behind.

entry.title: Vance, Trump issue plea for Americans to vote Republican on last night of convention
entry.summary: President Trump again touted his "Trump dividend" in his closing speech at the Republican convention. Vice President Vance used his remarks to urge voters to back Republicans, even if they disagree.
